sanskrit_verse:
तवाहमित्युपगतो युद्धप्राप्तः पणे जितः ।
प्रतिशीर्षप्रदानेन मुच्यते तुल्यकर्मणा ॥
transliteration: tavāham ity upagataḥ yuddha-prāptaḥ paṇe jitaḥ | pratīśīrṣa-pradānena mucyate tulya-karmaṇā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who approaches with 'I am yours' in a contest of battle or wager, having been won, is released by equal action through the offering of the head.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the completion of surrender and acceptance
Causation arises through mutual engagement under Dharma's witness
Capacity-based responsibility is fulfilled via equivalent restitution
Restoration occurs through symbolic parity and conscious completion
Consciousness alignment is achieved when both parties recognize the field of Dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF party A surrenders fully to party B in a recognized conflict OR wager AND party B accepts THEN the bond is sealed by mutual karmic liability
IF bond is sealed THEN release occurs ONLY upon equivalent counter-offering OR ritual restitution
IF restitution involves symbolic life-force exchange THEN completion requires pratīśīrṣa (head offering)
NO punitive consequence MAY arise IF restitution protocol IS executed per Dharma field recognition
ALL disputes ARISING from such bonds MUST be resolved within witness-consciousness framework
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving total surrender or existential contest, Supreme Courts must evaluate whether the bond was entered with full awareness and witnessed integrity. Release occurs not through judgment but through completion of reciprocal offering, aligning both parties with the causal symmetry of their actions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that true knowledge of consequence arises at moment of mutual entry into contest. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential resolution through equivalent response rather than external punishment. Responsibility flows from capacity to complete, not from error. The non-punitive reality rule holds that all karmic tension resolves through conscious reciprocity alone.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pratīśīrṣa completion ceremony witnessed by Dharma authority
Verify mutual acknowledgment of bond and readiness for restitution
Execute symbolic restitution aligned with original act’s energetic signature
Reintegrate both parties into unified consciousness field post-completion
Document final release in Akashic registry to prevent residual entanglement
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: surrender and contest resolve only through equal completion. There is no punishment, only restoration. Dharma prevails through consciousness realigned. Reality affirms its non-punitive nature. Consciousness itself is the ultimate Judge.
